category.name: Anxiety & Worry
category.description: When your mind won't stop racing and peace feels impossible.

prayers.title: When Anxious Thoughts Won't Stop
prayers.description: A prayer for when your mind spirals and you can't find the off switch.

prayers.title: When You're Completely Overwhelmed
prayers.description: Everything is too much. This prayer helps you breathe and hand it over.

prayers.title: Fear of the Future
prayers.description: When tomorrow terrifies you. A prayer to trust the One who holds it.

prayers.title: Peace in the Chaos
prayers.description: The storm is raging but Jesus is in the boat. A prayer for supernatural calm.

prayers.title: Letting Go of Control
prayers.description: You can't hold it all together. A prayer to release your grip and trust God's plan.

category.name: Sleep & Rest
category.description: Wind down, let go, and rest in God's presence.

prayers.title: When You Can't Sleep
prayers.description: Your body is tired but your mind won't quit. Let this prayer carry you to rest.

prayers.title: Nighttime Peace
prayers.description: A gentle prayer to close the day, release the weight, and sleep in God's arms.

prayers.title: Rest for the Weary
prayers.description: Come to me, all who are weary. A prayer for the bone-tired and burnt out.

prayers.title: Trusting God Through the Night
prayers.description: Darkness feels heavy. But morning is coming. A prayer for faith in the dark hours.

prayers.title: Surrender Before Sleep
prayers.description: Hand over the day — the wins, the failures, the unknowns. Sleep free.

category.name: Gratitude & Praise
category.description: Shift your focus from what's wrong to what's good.

prayers.title: A Thankful Heart
prayers.description: A prayer to notice the good, even in hard seasons. Gratitude changes everything.

prayers.title: Praise in the Storm
prayers.description: Everything is falling apart but you choose worship anyway. A prayer of defiant praise.

prayers.title: Morning Gratitude
prayers.description: Start the day with eyes wide open to God's goodness. A prayer for fresh mornings.

prayers.title: Counting Blessings
prayers.description: When you forget how good God has been. A prayer to remember and give thanks.

prayers.title: Joy in Small Things
prayers.description: Big miracles are rare. Small mercies are daily. A prayer to see them.

category.name: Healing & Sickness
category.description: When your body or heart needs God's healing touch.

prayers.title: Prayer for Physical Healing
prayers.description: Your body is broken. Bring it to the Healer. A prayer for restoration.

prayers.title: Prayer for Emotional Healing
prayers.description: The wound isn't visible but it's real. A prayer for the scars inside.

prayers.title: Healing for a Loved One
prayers.description: Someone you love is suffering and you feel helpless. Pray anyway.

prayers.title: When Healing Doesn't Come
prayers.description: You've prayed. Nothing changed. A prayer for endurance when God feels silent.

prayers.title: A Prayer for Your Mental Health
prayers.description: Depression, anxiety, numbness. God sees you in the pit. A prayer from the depths.

category.name: Strength & Courage
category.description: When you need backbone for what's ahead.

prayers.title: Courage to Act
prayers.description: You know what to do but fear holds you back. A prayer for holy boldness.

prayers.title: Facing Your Giants
prayers.description: The problem is bigger than you. Good — that means God gets the glory.

prayers.title: Standing Alone
prayers.description: Everyone else caved. You're the only one left standing. A prayer for the outnumbered.

prayers.title: Prayer for Endurance
prayers.description: The race is long and your legs are heavy. A prayer to keep going.

prayers.title: Armor Up
prayers.description: Put on the full armor of God. A prayer before you step into battle.

category.name: Forgiveness
category.description: Letting go of what was done to you — or what you've done.

prayers.title: Forgiving Someone Who Hurt You
prayers.description: They don't deserve it. Neither did you. A prayer to release the bitterness.

prayers.title: Asking God for Forgiveness
prayers.description: You blew it. Badly. But God's mercy is bigger than your mess.

prayers.title: Forgiving Yourself
prayers.description: God forgave you. Why can't you? A prayer to stop carrying what's already paid for.

prayers.title: A Broken Relationship
prayers.description: The bridge burned. Can it be rebuilt? A prayer for what feels beyond repair.

prayers.title: Letting Go of Anger
prayers.description: The rage feels justified. But it's eating you alive. A prayer to release it.

category.name: Family & Relationships
category.description: Praying over the people you love most.

prayers.title: Prayer for Your Marriage
prayers.description: Love is a daily choice. A prayer for patience, grace, and staying committed.

prayers.title: Prayer for Your Children
prayers.description: You can't protect them from everything. But you can cover them in prayer.

prayers.title: Honoring Your Parents
prayers.description: They're not perfect. Neither are you. A prayer for gratitude and grace.

prayers.title: When You Feel Alone
prayers.description: No one calls. No one sees. But God does. A prayer for the lonely.

prayers.title: Dealing with Difficult People
prayers.description: They drain you. A prayer for boundaries, wisdom, and not losing your mind.

category.name: Financial Stress
category.description: When money is tight and worry is loud.

prayers.title: Prayer for Provision
prayers.description: Bills are due. The account is empty. A prayer for God's supernatural supply.

prayers.title: Freedom from Debt
prayers.description: The weight of what you owe. A prayer for wisdom, discipline, and breakthrough.

prayers.title: A Heart of Generosity
prayers.description: Open hands, not clenched fists. A prayer to give freely and trust God for more.

prayers.title: Prayer for Contentment
prayers.description: Enough is enough. A prayer to stop chasing and start resting in what you have.

prayers.title: Prayer for Your Work
prayers.description: Monday dread or career confusion. A prayer for purpose and direction in your work.

category.name: Morning Prayers
category.description: Start your day anchored before the noise begins.

prayers.title: A New Day
prayers.description: Fresh mercies. Clean slate. A prayer to begin with intention and gratitude.

prayers.title: Surrendering This Day
prayers.description: Before the to-do list takes over — hand the day to God first.

prayers.title: Focus & Clarity
prayers.description: A clear mind, a steady heart. A prayer for wisdom before the chaos starts.

prayers.title: God's Presence Today
prayers.description: Don't leave home without it. A prayer to carry God's presence into every moment.

prayers.title: Walking in Purpose
prayers.description: Not just busy — intentional. A prayer to live today on purpose.

category.name: Evening Prayers
category.description: Close the day well. Release, reflect, rest.

prayers.title: End of Day
prayers.description: The day is done. A prayer to release what happened and rest in God's keeping.

prayers.title: Reflect & Release
prayers.description: What went well? What didn't? Hand it all back. Tomorrow is a new start.

prayers.title: Gratitude Tonight
prayers.description: Before your head hits the pillow — name three good things. Thank the Giver.

prayers.title: Protection Through the Night
prayers.description: Guardian angels and God's covering. A prayer for safety while you sleep.

prayers.title: Tomorrow Is in God's Hands
prayers.description: Stop planning. Stop worrying. Tomorrow belongs to Him. A prayer to let go.

category.name: Grief & Loss
category.description: When you've lost something or someone and the ache won't fade.

prayers.title: When You've Lost Someone
prayers.description: The chair is empty. The silence is loud. A prayer for the grief that won't let go.

prayers.title: When You're Asking 'Why?'
prayers.description: No answers. Just pain. A prayer for when God feels cruel or absent.

prayers.title: Grieving a Broken Dream
prayers.description: The life you planned isn't the life you got. A prayer to mourn what could have been.

prayers.title: Comfort in Pain
prayers.description: God doesn't always fix it. But He sits with you in it. A prayer for His presence.

prayers.title: Hope After Loss
prayers.description: Weeping lasts for the night, but joy comes in the morning. A prayer to believe that.

category.name: Decisions & Direction
category.description: When you don't know which way to go.

prayers.title: Facing a Big Decision
prayers.description: Left or right? Stay or go? A prayer for clarity when the path splits.

prayers.title: Knowing God's Will
prayers.description: What does God want me to do? A prayer to hear His voice above the noise.

prayers.title: Patience in Waiting
prayers.description: The answer hasn't come yet. A prayer for the unbearable in-between.

prayers.title: Prayer for a New Beginning
prayers.description: Closing one chapter, opening another. A prayer for courage to step forward.

prayers.title: Trusting God's Timing
prayers.description: It's taking too long. Or is it? A prayer to trust that God's clock is perfect.
